name: Anodot
description: Anodot AI-powered monitoring and anomaly detection

config.setupInstructions:
1. Sign in to Anodot as a customer-admin user.
2. Settings → API Tokens → +Add → name it and copy the Access Key.
3. Paste it below as the Access Key.
4. (Optional) Set Base URL to match your Anodot region.

credentialFields.label: Access Key
credentialFields.helpText: Anodot → Settings → API Tokens → create an Access Key as a customer-admin user.

credentialFields.label: Anodot Base URL
credentialFields.helpText: Region URL. Defaults to https://app.anodot.com. Examples: https://eu.anodot.com, https://ap.anodot.com, https://in.anodot.com, https://app-oregon.anodot.com.

checks.name: Monitoring & Alerting
